new_failures.name: second_provider::worker::memory_note_retries::a_voided_read_is_never_told_and_holds_the_next_until_it_ends
new_failures.observed_boundary: Only elapsed<50ms failed, with no numeric elapsed value; subsequent no-overlap, note equality, final fresh fact and five-open assertions were not reached.
new_failures.source_boundary_and_unresolved_state: Common added two synchronous synthetic observation-file writes inside Turns::answered and thus inside the timed span, plus new permission/context checks. A still-reading void is retained by tidy/ask_if_due and rejected by ready_now before done.wait_for. Ahead::ready may first await Pending permission; if the old read completed before forget, forget removes it and a new read may be selected. The failed run records none of those phase states or durations, so functional wait versus I/O/scheduling is unresolved.
